description.value: No. 1 Beef Noodle is a long-running Taiwanese restaurant in Burnaby that has been serving authentic beef noodle soup, bubble tea, hot pot, and dim sum since 2005. Originally conceived as a family-style dining destination, it has grown into one of the more popular Taiwanese spots in the Burnaby/Vancouver area with a wide menu spanning breakfast through late-night. Both pickup and delivery orders are available online, making it a convenient stop for cyclists moving through the Willingdon corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the business name, phone number (604) 438-6648, and address as 4741 Willingdon Avenue, Burnaby — matching OSM tags. Takeout is confirmed by prominent 'Online Order (Pickup)' and 'Online Order (Delivery)' links throughout the site. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM 'community' tag lists this as 'Vancouver' but the website consistently identifies the location as Burnaby; address corrected to Burnaby per website evidence.
A customer review mentions 'limited multi-layered parking space' referring to vehicle parking, not bike parking — no cycling infrastructure is mentioned anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active restaurant with confirmed takeout — a reasonable stop for touring cyclists — but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify at least bike visibility or a water refill option before including.

wow_evidence: one of the more popular Taiwanese spots in the Burnaby/Vancouver area
